text.e4mc_minecraft.closeServer: Local game no longer publicly hosted
text.e4mc_minecraft.doctor.start: Generating troubleshooting information. Please stand by.
text.mcpersist.addressInUse: This world's address is already in use. Is a copy of this world open somewhere else?
text.mcpersist.addressRefused: The MCPersist relay couldn't give this world its address.
options.mcpersist.persistent.tooltip: After you leave, this world keeps running in the background and starts again every time you log in to your computer, until you click Stop Background Server in the world list. This accepts the Minecraft EULA (aka.ms/MinecraftEULA).
selectWorld.mcpersist.resetAddress.title: Give this world a new address?
selectWorld.mcpersist.resetAddress.messa: Anyone using the old address won't be able to join any more. Share the new one with your friends after opening the world.
text.mcpersist.whitelistOn: The whitelist is on, so only players you add can join. Before a friend joins for the first time, run %s
text.mcpersist.howToShare: MCPersist: to share this world, press Esc, click World Options... and turn LAN on.
text.mcpersist.movingToBackground: This world is moving to a background server. Rejoin in a moment.
selectWorld.mcpersist.runningInBackgroun: Running in the background. Click to join
selectWorld.mcpersist.waitingForBackgrou: Waiting for the background server to start...
selectWorld.mcpersist.backgroundNotStart: It's running but not accepting players after a minute. Try Stop Background Server, then open the world again.
mcpersist.problem.failed.title: The background server for %s stopped unexpectedly
mcpersist.problem.failed.message: It won't be restarted automatically, and your world files weren't changed by the failure. Details: %s
mcpersist.problem.interrupted.title: %s closed without moving to the background
mcpersist.problem.interrupted.message: The game or the world stopped before the world could be handed to its background server. Start its background server now?
